overview_description.description:
Udora is a fast-growing gifting platform connecting customers with local florists, confectioners, and artisan makers across 50+ countries and 1,500+ cities, including MENA, UK, Spain and LATAM. The startup combines personalized technology with a human touch to modernize one of the world's most traditional retail verticals. 

Putting sellers at the heart of our business, we provide them access to a loyal and paying worldwide audience. Innovative tools together with marketing instruments help local businesses from 50+ countries scale and promote their products. That's our core value in making small businesses closer to customers both locally and abroad. We equally want to help a friend from London surprise their loved ones in Abu Dhabi, or a student in Dubai send a birthday gift to his grandma in Madrid.
For customers, we provide a one-stop solution to find the perfect gift with ease and convenience: same-day delivery, product photos before delivery, a calendar of important dates, and curated collections from local shops. People worldwide can surprise their loved ones with flowers, confectionery, craft and handmade items, plants, and jewellery from local makers across 1,500+ cities. https://udora.ae/

product.name: Udora Gifting Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace that connects customers with local florists, bakeries, gift shops, and other sellers for ordering gifts and arranging delivery.

product.name: Flower Delivery
product.description: Online ordering of bouquets, roses, flower boxes, baskets, gift sets, and individual flowers from local florists, with eligible same-day or next-day delivery.

product.name: Edible Bouquets and Fruit Arrangements
product.description: Gift arrangements made with fresh fruit, berries, chocolate-covered strawberries, macarons, and other sweets, available for delivery from local sellers.

product.name: Cakes and Sweet Gifts
product.description: Custom cakes, cupcakes, pies, chocolate-covered strawberries, confectionery sets, and other desserts supplied by local bakeries and pastry sellers.

product.name: Plants and Potted Flower Gifts
product.description: Potted plants and flowering gifts, including orchids and other indoor plants, available for local delivery.

product.name: Balloons and Celebration Decorations
product.description: Balloon gifts and decorative arrangements, including balloon sets, balloon fountains, and balloons with custom inscriptions.
